correctness.rationale: Exact parity restriction on summand count yields the q=1..5 residue formulas. The three-part Gaussian-unimodality bound and elementary five-part lower bound guarantee threshold coverage for every residue. Two-part counts differ by one at exactly the stated positions. The endpoint and p=0,1 cases are explicitly proved; independent capped denumerant dynamic programming agrees for 5,843 parameter instances (a=4..150), not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A canonical p-representation sensitivity question for adjacent natural generator families has an exact, uniform and bounded answer despite parameter a growing. The theorem determines every changed integer and hence its p-genus and first-moment changes, explains an odd maximum-p boundary anomaly, and identifies a four-integer exceptional p=1 layer. The existing p-Frobenius maxima do not determine these structural facts; this is not an arbitrary finite slice.
